26:138.text: And we are not to be punished."

26:139.text: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

26:140.text: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

26:142.text: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

26:143.text: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

26:144.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

26:145.text: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

26:146.text: Will you be left in what is here, secure

26:148.text: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

26:149.text: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

26:150.text: So fear Allāh and obey me.

26:151.text: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

26:152.text: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

26:153.text: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

26:154.text: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

26:157.text: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
